# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_hold_inventions.py". Change the tables there and re-run.

# Buttons of the "Hold's Inventions" panel (Inventions window, Unique page).
# Frames: 1 unknown, 2 known, 3 active, 4 project under way.
custom_button = {
	name = DA_Runesmith_invention_Hold_Amldihr
	tooltip = DA_hold_inv_button_Amldihr_tt
	potential = {
		has_country_flag = DA_DH_sel_Hold_Amldihr
	}
	frame = { number = 3 trigger = { has_estate_privilege = DA_RS_HOLD_Amldihr } }
	frame = { number = 2 trigger = { has_country_flag = DA_RS_HOLD_Amldihr_enabled } }
	frame = { number = 4 trigger = { has_estate_privilege = DA_RS_project_Hold_Amldihr } }
	frame = { number = 1 trigger = { always = yes } }
	trigger = {
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = DA_hold_inv_owns_Amldihr_tt
			owns_core_province = 4119
		}
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = DA_hold_inv_not_running_tt
			NOT = { has_estate_privilege = DA_RS_project_Hold_Amldihr }
		}
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = DA_hold_inv_ready_tt
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = DA_RS_HOLD_Amldihr_enabled
				AND = {
					DA_RS_has_points_for_advanced = yes
					DA_has_NO_Project_active = yes
					treasury = 1000
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RS_HOLD_Amldihr_enabled } }
			custom_tooltip = DA_hold_inv_starts_project_tt
			set_estate_privilege = DA_RS_project_Hold_Amldihr
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_estate_privilege = DA_RS_HOLD_Amldihr }
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_RS_HOLD_Amldihr
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_RS_has_points_for_advanced = yes }
			set_estate_privilege = DA_RS_HOLD_Amldihr
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = DA_Runesmith_cannot_afford_invention
			tooltip = {
				set_estate_privilege = DA_RS_HOLD_Amldihr
			}
		}
	}
}

			remove_estate_privilege = DA_RS_HOLD_Ovdal_Lodhum
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_RS_has_points_for_advanced = yes }
			set_estate_privilege = DA_RS_HOLD_Ovdal_Lodhum
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = DA_Runesmith_cannot_afford_invention
			tooltip = {
				set_estate_privilege = DA_RS_HOLD_Ovdal_Lodhum
			}
		}
	}
}
custom_button = {
	name = DA_Runesmith_invention_Hold_Tuwad_Dhumankon
	tooltip = DA_hold_inv_button_Tuwad_Dhumankon_tt
	potential = {
		has_country_flag = DA_DH_sel_Hold_Tuwad_Dhumankon
	}
	frame = { number = 3 trigger = { has_estate_privilege = DA_RS_HOLD_Tuwad_Dhumankon } }
	frame = { number = 2 trigger = { has_country_flag = DA_RS_HOLD_Tuwad_Dhumankon_enabled } }
	frame = { number = 4 trigger = { has_estate_privilege = DA_RS_project_Hold_Tuwad_Dhumankon } }
	frame = { number = 1 trigger = { always = yes } }
	trigger = {
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = DA_hold_inv_owns_Tuwad_Dhumankon_tt
			owns_core_province = 4350
		}
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = DA_hold_inv_not_running_tt
			NOT = { has_estate_privilege = DA_RS_project_Hold_Tuwad_Dhumankon }
		}
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = DA_hold_inv_ready_tt
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = DA_RS_HOLD_Tuwad_Dhumankon_enabled
				AND = {
					DA_RS_has_points_for_advanced = yes
					DA_has_NO_Project_active = yes
					treasury = 1000
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RS_HOLD_Tuwad_Dhumankon_enabled } }
			custom_tooltip = DA_hold_inv_starts_project_tt
			set_estate_privilege = DA_RS_project_Hold_Tuwad_Dhumankon
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_estate_privilege = DA_RS_HOLD_Tuwad_Dhumankon }
			remove_estate_privilege = DA_RS_HOLD_Tuwad_Dhumankon
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_RS_has_points_for_advanced = yes }
			set_estate_privilege = DA_RS_HOLD_Tuwad_Dhumankon
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = DA_Runesmith_cannot_afford_invention
			tooltip = {
				set_estate_privilege = DA_RS_HOLD_Tuwad_Dhumankon
			}
		}
	}
}
